study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual deviations from normative models of brain structure in a large cross-sectional schizophrenia cohort

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Participants were from the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB), which provided structural and diffusion-weighted MRI, genetic data, and clinical assessments.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Here, we developed normative models of FA and CT across the lifespan using harmonized MRI data from healthy adults (18 -65 years) participating in the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank [28].
